results.dataset: FAR NHL registry, Czech Republic (Spinar et al. PLoS One 2019)
results.metric: Heart failure, all MAGGIC inputs: C-index (2-year outcome)
results.notes: Patient-level, outpatients with ejection fraction < 50% (MAGGIC layer). Every MAGGIC input taken from the registry. The registry's 2-year outcome is death, heart transplant or LVAD (combined); its date is not given, so only 2-year survival can be compared.

results.dataset: England first-ever stroke, SSNAP national register (Bray et al. 2018)
results.metric: Stroke: predicted 1-year survival
results.notes: Published cohort, independent of the stroke layer's sources: predicted at admission (stroke layer), with ages spread evenly within each published quartile (median 77, IQR 66-85; ends 18 and 100 assumed) and the cohort's sex mix.
